scores.claim_text: Boeing holds the KC-46A Tanker EMD contract plus 10 authorized LRIP lots (139 aircraft) for USAF; EMD + authorized lots ~$27B as of 12/31/2023.
supports: pentagon_jbook program_name='KC-46A Tanker' => primary_match KC-46A Tanker Squadrons (PE 0401221F), status FUNDED_STEADY, latest_funded_year 2024, latest_funded_M $78.7M (Air Force RDT&E line; operations-side; LRIP procurement also separately funded as P-40 line).

usaspending.query_dod_contracts for 'Boeing' returns 98,895 awards / $209B total; top award FA862511C6600 'KC-X MODERNIZATION PROGRAM' $31.96B — confirms the KC-46A contract Boeing claims actually exists in USAspending.
scores.M_value: FUNDED_STEADY (PE 0401221F, FY24 $78.7M RDT&E) + USAspending KC-X $31.96B confirmed
scores.interpretation: J-Book confirms KC-46A is a steadily funded USAF program of record at the cutoff; USAspending corroborates Boeing as prime on a $31.96B KC-X modernization award. Boeing's forward narrative on KC-46 is consistent with Pentagon budgets. No divergence detected.
